note: Per-device power reference for battery-life estimation. Current draws are approximate, community/datasheet-derived figures for a MeshCore companion/repeater workload (radio in continuous RX, display behaviour varies by firmware build) and are NOT regulatory or vendor guarantees. Capacity is the *typical* pack shipped/used with the board; many boards take a user-supplied cell, so treat capacity as a hint and prefer observed drain. The only hardware signal the companion protocol exposes is the free-form DeviceInfo.manufacturer string (+ firmware version), so matching is substring-based and case-insensitive.
